about: Merchant line (Merchant 6100, Blacksmith 6200, Whitesmith 6300, Mechanic 6400): skill mechanics SkillConfig does not carry, read from each skill's own description and timeline (SkillMechanics.cs documents every field). The original server scripts are not in the client, so every entry is inferred; 'why' quotes the evidence. Axe Tornado (16304) and High-Energy Impact (16307) are scheduled in CombatService.CastImpacts. Talent proc rows without a usable text of their own (16010, 16205) quote their talent's BuffConfig text; 'group:mode' keys override a mode row (Arm Cannon's enhanced volleys).

16313.name: Vulcan Arm
16313.why: 'Every «15» casts of [Vulcan Arm] trigger [Firepower Loaded] «1» times. [Firepower Loaded]: Increases the number of Cannon shells Launched by each [Arm Cannon] attack to «8» for «3» attacks': _kBuff1 [[1631301, 10000, 15000], [1631701, 10000, -1]] (mode 1: 1631501) gave Firepower Loaded on every cast. 1631301 'Firepower Ready: At @{1} stacks, triggers [Firepower Loading]' stacks to 15 (_iStackType 7, _iMaxStack 15); Firepower Loaded has _iMaxStack 3. So the grant waits for 15 piles of the counter, which it then spends, and comes with 3 piles (one per Arm Cannon - Enhance shot, consumePiles on 16312 modes 1/3/4).

16006.name: Cart Revolution
16006.why: 'up to @{2} selected enemies within @{1} meters and up to «3» other enemies within «2» meters of them': a 2 m splash around the locked target, 1 + 3 targets (_iTargetMax is 1).

16010.name: Gunpowder Throw
16010.why: The row's own text is a copy of Cart Revolution's ('Ram enemies with your cart, dealing Physical ATK * «10»% + «40» Neutral ... up to «5» other enemies within «2» meters of them') although _iEleType is 4 (Fire). Its talent text (10220300051, buff 1640301 _kDescData ['4','5','10','40','1.5']) matches the row: 'After using [Cart Revolution], immediately trigger «1» instances of [Gunpowder Throw], dealing Fire melee Physical damage equal to PATK * «10»% + «40» to up to «5» enemies within «4» meters': a 4 m area around the locked target (Lock, _iRangeType 2, empty kRange), 5 targets in total (_iTargetMax is 1).

16201.name: Cart Boost
16201.why: 'Increases your Movement Speed by «20»% and removes [Slow] from you for «5» sec': _kBuff1 is the speed buff 1620110 and 1620201 (the High Speed Cart Ram mode switch); nothing removes [Slow]. Cleanses every BuffConfig group named 'Slow' (11606, 12111, 12309, 12367, 12484, 14016, 15009, 16306, 23362, 23434, 49009, 50049, 111652, 115326, 215307) once at the cast; the 5 s immunity is not modelled.

16205.name: Explosive Strike (High Speed Cart Ram talent proc)
16205.why: The row has no description; its talent text (10220300067, buff 1646301 _kDescData ['4','5','20','100','1.5']): '[High Speed Cart Ram] triggers [Explosive Strike] an Extra «1» times when cast, dealing Neutral melee Physical damage equal to PATK * «20»% + «100» to up to «5» enemies within «4» meters' (row P1 2000, P2 100). Lock with _iRangeType 2 and empty kRange would use the 3 m default and _iTargetMax 1: 4 m around the locked target, 5 targets.

16308.name: Crescent Wheel
16308.why: 'Throw flying axes around you, dealing ... totaling PATK * «600»% to up to «4» members of the Enemy Team within a «7»-meter radius': circle of 7 m around the caster (_kRange 750 = 7.5 m); one hit of P1 60000 is the total.

16350.name: High-Energy Pulse
16350.why: 'Releases a pulse within a «8» m radius, dealing Physical ATK * «200»% ... «1» times' (mode 1: 'Release a pulse in a «8»-meter radius around you'): circle of 8 m around the caster (_kRange 750 = 7.5 m).

16305.name: Heavy Axe Smash
16305.why: 'Move rapidly in front of the target, dealing ... to up to «5» enemies within a «3»-meter radius': the 3 m area is around the locked target, not the caster (kRange is empty, the old default 3 m sat on the requested point).

16306.name: Spinning Axe
16306.why: '«2» hits ... totaling PATK * «200»% ... in a «5» * «11»-meter rectangular area in front of you': _kDamageParam1 is 100% per hit and the template has two attack points (0.18, 0.43 s), one axe pass each; the 11 x 5 m rectangle starts at the caster (DragRect would centre it on the dragged point).

16312.name: Arm Cannon
16312.why: 'Launch «4» Cannon shells at «1» selected enemies ... and up to «5» Other enemies within «6» meters of them, dealing ... totaling PATK * «80»%': 40% per volley (_kDamageParam1 4000) at each of the two attack points (0.1, 0.2 s), each shown as 2 shells (_kShowDmg [2]) = 4 shells, 80% in total; 6 m splash around the target, 1 + 5 targets.

16312:1.name: Arm Cannon - Enhance (Firepower Loaded)
16312:1.why: Mode 1 (set by [Firepower Loaded] 1631701 -> 1632001 _kSkillAttributeList [0,16312,15,1,1]): 'Launch «8» Cannon shells at «1» selected enemies within «15» meters and up to «5» Other enemies within «6» meters of them, dealing ... totaling PATK * «160»%': P1 4000 (40%) shown as 2 shells (_kShowDmg [2]); 4 volleys x 2 shells x 40% = 8 shells, 160%, on the first four of the five attack points of template 163121 (0.08, 0.12, 0.2, 0.23 s; the group entry's two points would deal only 80%). Same 6 m splash around the target, 1 + 5 targets.

16312:3.name: Arm Cannon - Enhance (Melody talent + Firepower Loaded)
16312:3.why: Mode 3 (same script ArmCannonPro and template 163121 as mode 1): 'Launch «8» Cannon shells at «1» selected enemies within «15» meters and up to «5» Other enemies within «6» meters of them, dealing ... totaling PATK * «160»%' with P1 4000, _kShowDmg [2]: 4 volleys x 40% = 160% on attack points 0-3; 6 m around the target, 1 + 5 targets.

16312:4.name: Melody Cannon - Enhance
16312:4.why: Mode 4 (template 1631212, five attack points 0.08-0.28 s): 'Launch «12» Cannon rounds at «1» designated enemies within «15» meters and up to «5» Other enemies within «6» meters around them, dealing total ... PATK*«208»%': P1 5200 (52%) shown as 3 rounds (_kShowDmg [3]); 4 volleys x 3 rounds x 52% = 12 rounds, 208%, on attack points 0-3; 6 m around the target, 1 + 5 targets.

16314.name: Pile Bunker
16314.why: 'at «1» selected enemies within «15» meters of you and up to «5» enemies within «4» meters of them ... inflicting «8»-meter Knockback, and inflicting Stun for «0.5» seconds': 4 m splash around the target (kRange [100, 1] is not it), the Stun is not in _kBuff2. The 8 m knockback is the PileBunker displacement rule.

16315.name: Flame Launcher
16315.why: 'on «1» selected enemies within «15» meters of you, dealing «3» hits ... totaling PATK * «600»% to up to «5» targets in a «7» * «15»-meter rectangular area in front of you': a 15 m long, 7 m wide strip from the caster toward the target (the cast faces the locked target).

16317.name: Energy Release
16317.why: 'Consumes HP equal to «50»% of your Max HP and converts it into a [Shield] ... then begins a «3»-second countdown before using Energy Release': no damage at the cast; the countdown buff 1634401 carries the shield and its _kLogicData [16352] names the explosion, released 3 s later as skill 1635201.

16352.name: Energy Release (explosion)
16352.why: 'When the countdown ends, deal ... PATK * «2200»% to up to «10» targets within a «10»-meter radius ... You then lose «50»% of your current Max HP. This HP loss cannot be fatal. Reduces MSPD by @{1}% for «5» seconds' (the slow is its _kBuff1 1634801).

16318.name: Aerial Bombardment
16318.why: 'Bombard a «15» * «10»-meter area in the specified direction ... deal ... totaling PATK * «2100»% to up to «5» enemies along the path': 300% per bomb (_kDamageParam1 30000, shown in 3, _kShowDmg [3]) at each of the seven attack points after take-off (1.65-2.67 s) = 2100%; the 15 x 10 m strip lies from where the run started, in the chosen direction.
